 Oral Judgment
Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is filed assailing the judgment and award dated 24.11.2023 in MVC No.229/2020, on the file of the learned Principal District and Sessions Judge and MACT at Raichur (hereinafter referred to as 'Tribunal') awarding compensation.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1053 HC-KAR 3.
Having taken note of the submission made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, it is not in dispute as to the occurrence of the accident on 09.12.2019.
The perusal of the wound certificate at Ex.P4 reflects that, the claimant has sustained fracture of right side multiple ribs and also surgical treatment was undergone by the claimant.

sentences.text: Though the learned counsel appearing for the appellant/claimant submitted that, the disability has to be taken into consideration based on the wound certificate, however, the same was opposed by the learned counsel representing the Insurance Company on the ground that, the treating doctor has been not examined to assess the disability.

In that view of the matter, taking into consideration the injuries sustained by the claimant, particularly, as to the fracture of the right side rib of the claimant, I am of the view that, the claimant is entitled for global compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- in addition to the award made by the Tribunal.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1053 HC-KAR 5.

In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER I.
The appeal is allowed in part.

II. The appellant/claimant is entitled for global compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- including the compensation awarded by the Tribunal, with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realization.
III. Respondent No.3 - Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation amount within six weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.

Sd/-
